query.description: Census Data API query: variables (get) for a geography (for/in, or state/county/place/zcta names). ACS estimates come with their margins of error.

dataset.desc: dataset path (2024/acs/acs5, 2024/acs/acs1/subject, 2020/dec/pl) or 'latest/acs/acs5', or a catalog alias (acs5, acs1, acs5_subject, dec_pl_2020, pep_charv)

get.desc: variables, comma-separated or a list (NAME,B19013_001E) or group(B19013); for ACS every ...E estimate gets its ...M margin of error added

for.desc: geography: state:*, state:24, county:*, place:04000, tract:*, zip code tabulation area:20850, us:1

ucgid.desc: uniform Census geography id, e.g. 0400000US24 (instead of for/in)

state.desc: convenience: state name, USPS code or FIPS (Maryland, MD, 24), or *

county.desc: convenience: county name (Montgomery), 3-digit or 5-digit FIPS, or *; needs state

place.desc: convenience: city, town or CDP name (Baltimore) or 5-digit place code; needs state

zcta.desc: convenience: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ACS 5-year and decennial)

moe.desc: true (default): add ...M for every ...E in ACS; false is refused for ACS (margins of error are never dropped)

group_variables.description: Every variable of one table (group): code, label, concept, type. Use before choosing variables.

group.desc: table id, e.g. B19013, S1701, DP03, P1

groups.description: Every table (group) of a dataset with its title.

acs5.name: ACS 5-year detailed tables (latest)
acs5.description: American Community Survey 5-year estimates, every geography down to block group; released each December (2024 = 2020-2024)

acs1.name: ACS 1-year detailed tables (latest)
acs1.description: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, areas of 65,000+ people; released each September (none for 2020)

acs5_subject.name: ACS 5-year subject tables (S...)
acs5_subject.description: ready-made percentages and medians, e.g. S1701 poverty, S1901 income

acs5_profile.name: ACS 5-year data profiles (DP02-DP05)
acs5_profile.description: social, economic, housing, demographic profiles; ...PE percent estimates

dec_pl_2020.name: 2020 Census redistricting data (P.L. 94-171)
dec_pl_2020.description: decennial census counts: population P1, race, Hispanic origin, voting age, housing occupancy; to block level; variables end in N

dec_dhc_2020.name: 2020 Census Demographic and Housing Characteristics
dec_dhc_2020.description: decennial census age, sex, households, tenure

pep_charv.name: Population estimates by characteristics (latest vintage on the API)
pep_charv.description: annual resident population estimates POP by YEAR, MONTH, AGE, SEX, HISP; vintage 2023 (July 2020-2023) is the latest on the API (October 2026); nation, state, county and metro areas, no places; vintages 2022 and 2024-2025 are not on the API

pep_population_2019.name: Population estimates, vintage 2019
pep_population_2019.description: annual population estimates 2010-2019 (DATE_CODE); every geography down to places and county subdivisions; the last vintage on the API with place estimates

pep_population_2021.name: Population estimates, vintage 2021
pep_population_2021.description: POP_2020, POP_2021 (July 1), POP_BASE2020, changes and ranks; nation, region, division and state only; newer totals are in pep_charv

cbp.name: County Business Patterns 2023
cbp.description: establishments, employment, payroll by NAICS and county

ecnbasic_2022.name: Economic Census 2022, basic statistics
ecnbasic_2022.description: Economic Census establishments, sales, payroll by industry

sipp.name: Survey of Income and Program Participation (latest)
sipp.description: SIPP public-use microdata: one row per person-month of the reference year (the file year minus one); weight by WPFINWGT

B01003_001E.name: Total population
B01003_001E.description: ACS total population (table B01003); B01001_001E is the same total from the sex-by-age table

B19013_001E.name: Median household income (inflation-adjusted dollars of the survey year)
B19013_001E.description: median household income in the past 12 months

B19301_001E.name: Per capita income
B19301_001E.description: per capita income in the past 12 months

B17001_002E.name: Population below poverty level
B17001_002E.description: income in the past 12 months below poverty level; universe B17001_001E (population for whom poverty status is determined)

S1701_C03_001E.name: Poverty rate (percent below poverty level)
S1701_C03_001E.description: subject table S1701, use dataset acs5_subject or acs1_subject

B25077_001E.name: Median home value (owner-occupied units)
B25077_001E.description: median value, owner-occupied housing; top-coded at 2000001 ($2,000,000 or more)

B25064_001E.name: Median gross rent
B25064_001E.description: median gross rent; top-coded as 2001, 3501 or 4001 ($2,000+, $3,500+, $4,000+ depending on year)

B25003_002E.name: Owner-occupied housing units
B25003_002E.description: tenure; universe B25003_001E occupied units; renter B25003_003E

B15003_022E.name: Bachelor's degree (population 25+)
B15003_022E.description: educational attainment; universe B15003_001E; master's _023E, professional _024E, doctorate _025E

B23025_005E.name: Unemployed (civilian labor force)
B23025_005E.description: employment status; civilian labor force B23025_003E

B27001_001E.name: Health insurance coverage universe
B27001_001E.description: health insurance coverage status by sex by age; S2701 subject table has uninsured rates

B02001_002E.name: White alone
B02001_002E.description: race; Black or African American alone B02001_003E

P1_001N.name: Total population (2020 Census count)
P1_001N.description: decennial 2020 P.L. 94-171 total population; dataset dec_pl_2020

POP.name: Population estimate (PEP)
POP.description: population estimates: dataset pep_charv, with YEAR and MONTH predicates
